name: MemHub Universal Memory
description: Shares MemHub local memory (global ~/.memory + project .memory) with PI-Desktop: session-start memory catalog and handoffs, per-turn and tool-error retrieval, and tools to search, load, propose and forget memories. Runs in-process; the HTTP daemon is only a fallback.
safetyNotes: Reads and writes only MemHub memory stores (~/.memory and <project>/.memory) in-process. Falls back to the local MemHub daemon at 127.0.0.1:4789 when the bundled core is missing. Optional: when MEMHUB_RERANK_* or MEMHUB_REVIEW_* environment variables are set, memory headers (rerank) or redacted conversation text (background review) are sent to that user-configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint; review results only enter the inbox for approval. Physical deletion requires confirm=true.

agentTools.name: search
agentTools.description: Search global and project memories by query. Returns IDs, scopes, titles, and one-line summaries (no bodies).

agentTools.name: load
agentTools.description: Load full Markdown content of one memory entry by exact ID and update last_access.

agentTools.name: propose
agentTools.description: Write long-term memory or update a task handoff. Long-term: only what stays true after the task ends (global if true in any project, else project); same title supersedes the old conclusion. Handoff (scope="handoff"): cross-session task state keyed by task; resubmitting the same task updates it in place, status done/abandoned archives it. Commits directly unless requireReview is true.

requireReview.description: Optional: queue to inbox instead of committing immediately.

title.description: State the conclusion itself, e.g. "生产镜像必须指定 linux/amd64".

summary.description: One line: when / under which conditions it applies.

content.description: Full text. For handoffs use: 目标 / 验收标准 (- [ ] / - [x] + 证据) / 下一步 / 阻塞 / 相关文件.

triggers.description: Situations and synonyms that should recall this memory (e.g. 上线, 部署, docker build).

paths.description: Optional project-relative globs this memory is tied to (e.g. packages/daemon/**).

scope.description: global: still true in any project. project: true only for this repo. handoff: cross-session task state that stops mattering once the task ends.

task.description: Handoff only: stable task key (branch or short task name). Same key updates the same handoff in place.

status.description: Handoff only. done requires every acceptance item checked with evidence.

ttl_days.description: Handoff only: expire after N days without update (default 14).

agentTools.name: forget
agentTools.description: Deprecate or archive an existing memory entry autonomously, or physically delete with confirm=true after explicit user approval.

confirm.description: Required true only for irreversible mode="delete".
